# Ollama provenance

- Project: Ollama
- Upstream: https://github.com/ollama/ollama
- License: MIT
- MALENJO integration: loopback HTTP API only
- Binary vendored in this repository: no
- Model weights vendored in this repository: no
- Automatic model download: no

The Phase 5 adapter uses the local Ollama API for runtime/version/model discovery and chat generation. The application does not redistribute Ollama binaries or model weights.

Model licenses are independent of the Ollama runtime license and must be reviewed per model.
